entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say or enter your order number now.
Thank you. Connecting you to an agent now.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Isaac. I see you're calling about order VF81138-9. How can I...
Look, I need to return the cycling shoes on that order. Just tell me if I can do it and send me the label. I don't have a lot of time.
I can certainly help you with that. I just need to ask one or two quick questions to process this correctly. What specifically is the issue with the shoes? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
They don't work for me. I've tried adjusting the cleats a dozen times, but they're still giving me terrible blisters on my long rides. I just want a refund. Yes or no, can I return these?
Yes, absolutely. I understand completely. Let me just confirm the purchase date... I see they were delivered 33 days ago. You are well within our 90-day return policy for a full refund.
Okay, good. So what do I do?

I've just approved the return in our system. I'm sending the pre-paid return label to your email on file right now. And since you're a VIP member, I've also added a $20 credit to your account for the trouble. You should see both of those emails in the next few minutes.
A label and a credit. Fine. That's efficient. Thank you.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist with today?
Great. Thank you for calling VeloFit and have a wonderful day.
